title: Strand AI on Minute 52
summary: Oded Falik joins Kate Kreuger on the Minute 52 podcast to talk about building Strand AI, YC Demo Day, and bringing spatial proteomics to drug discovery.
body_markdown:
# Strand AI on Minute 52


April 2026 Oded Falik


I had a great conversation with Kate Kreuger on the second episode of **Minute 52** . We got into what we're building at Strand AI and how YC W26 has gone. We also talked about how our background in medical data pulled us into spatial proteomics.


Thanks to Kate for having me on. If you're curious about what Strand AI does or want to learn more about imputing missing biological modalities, give it a listen.
